description: Na₄Ge₂Se₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-13°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.16 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-13°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.95-3.22 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-9°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.00-3.15 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-4°. There are four shorter (3.07 Å) and two longer (3.12 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-8°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.19 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There are two shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.47 Å) Ge-Se bond length. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There are two shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.46 Å) Ge-Se bond length. There are five inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-89°. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and two Ge atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄Ge₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-85°. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-89°. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-88°. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Ge atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-88°.
